name: Processor B heavy-hex candidate (7 qubits)
topology_description: 7-qubit connected piece of a heavy-hex lattice: every qubit has at most three neighbours and there are no triangles. Because the shortest heavy-hex loop is 12 qubits, this piece is a tree.
stage: Provisional comparison variant (not a replacement for Phase 1 Processor B)
source: participant-defined research model; qubit count must be confirmed with the organizers
note: Participant-defined research model. Not an organizer-issued edge list and not calibrated hardware. Noise values are the same simulator assumptions as Phase 1.
